title: Native formation fluctuations in immutable-record waves
research_target: Derive a native neighbor-dependent formation fluctuation theorem for the supplied seven- or fifteen-state exchange law, or isolate an explicit obstruction. The cubic centering coefficient is extracted at j=0 under symmetric stirring: obtain a controlled fixed-j remainder before using it to center a driven wave process.
completion_criterion: Check the reaction-adjoint constant/linear cancellation and exact nonproduct adjacent-covariance witness with disjoint algebra. Identify every conserved field in the relevant symbol, then prove or explicitly isolate the missing replacement/centering estimate.
